school_name: Arlington Memorial High School (Arlington Memorial Middle & High School)
su_sd_note: SVSU (svsu.org) site header reads 'Southwest Vermont Supervisory Union'; the AMHS 2026-27 School Profile states 'Arlington School District is part of the Southwest Vermont Supervisory Union.' Exact match.

school_status_notes: SVSU calendar lists 'Act 170 Merger Committee' meetings (Nov 2026), i.e. statewide district consolidation planning that may affect Arlington's governance. Profile: 106 students in grades 9-12, 91 in grades 6-8.
how_found: Web search > school site menu About > Program of Studies > '2026/2027 Program of Studies' link (PDF)
issues: None major. Graduation requirements (26 credits incl. 16 in required areas, 32 community service hours) are on p.6 of the catalog itself; no separate grad-requirements document found. No 2025-26 Program of Studies found on the site (only 2026-27 linked; an orphaned 2022-23 PDF is still hosted). Course descriptions pp.9-26 by department (Arts, English, Library Media, Math, PE/Wellness, Science, Social Studies, Special Ed, World Languages), plus Dual Enrollment, Work-Based Learning, Southwest Tech pp.27-28. Middle-school (grades 6-8) courses not evidently included.
